definitions: To harm oneself in an attempt to harm another person, often out of anger or resentment.
examples: She refused to cooperate with the new manager, cutting off her nose to spite her face by jeopardising her own promotion.
lemma: to cut nose off to spite sb face
synonyms: to shoot oneself in the foot
to bite off one's nose to spite one's face
source: to cut nose off to spite sb face
